limits: No embedding/reranker/production answer-model evaluation or external paid dispatch. This repository apparatus is deterministic lexical retrieval.
Ranking success is document destination selection, not answer truth, runtime correctness or physical acceptance.
Old answer audits qualify only their hashed saved inputs. Any changed final text/order requires explicit delta or fresh review.
Frozen historical and older-source question facts are retained; they can be source-bounded expectations instead of current implementation assertions.
External caches/importers are not controlled here. Rebuild and preserve per-chunk authority and selection boundaries.
recommendation: Keep Draft/HOLD; documentation and retrieval qualification do not grant owner merge, runtime publication, CI-policy change or physical acceptance.
